about: Real films and serials the mock panel can show with their real artwork: open movies (Creative Commons) and public-domain classics. Facts from TMDB, synopses written for Nimbus, artwork and video from Wikimedia Commons (see fetch_art.py). Listed newest-added first.

films.title: Spring
films.plot: A shepherd girl and her loyal dog face the ancient spirits of the mountains to keep the seasons turning.

films.title: Charade
films.cast: Cary Grant, Audrey Hepburn, Walter Matthau
films.plot: After her husband is murdered, Regina Lampert is chased across Paris by three men who want the fortune he stole, and by a charming stranger whose name keeps changing.

films.title: Sintel
films.cast: Halina Reijn, Thom Hoffman
films.plot: A lonely young woman nurses a baby dragon back to health, and when it is snatched away she sets out across a harsh world to find it.

films.title: Night of the Living Dead
films.cast: Judith O'Dea, Duane Jones, Marilyn Eastman
films.plot: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and lay siege through the night.
films.poster: Night Of The Living Dead (1968) - Poster.jpg

films.title: Sprite Fright
films.cast: Valerie LaPointe, Gabriel Bisset-Smith, Nicole Davis
films.plot: Rowdy teenagers on a trip into a British forest meet its tiny mushroom sprites, who turn out to be far less peaceful than they look.
films.video: Sprite Fright - Blender Open Movie-full movie.webm

films.title: His Girl Friday
films.cast: Cary Grant, Rosalind Russell, Ralph Bellamy
films.plot: A fast-talking newspaper editor will stop at nothing to keep his star reporter, who happens to be his ex-wife, from remarrying and leaving the paper.

films.title: Big Buck Bunny
films.plot: A big-hearted rabbit's peaceful day in the meadow is spoiled by three bullying rodents, so he plans a sweet revenge.

films.title: The General
films.cast: Buster Keaton, Marion Mack, Glen Cavender
films.plot: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Confederate engineer gives chase alone, by rail, deep behind enemy lines.

films.title: Tears of Steel
films.cast: Derek de Lint, Sergio Hasselbaink, Vanja Rukavina
films.plot: In a ruined future Amsterdam, a band of scientists and soldiers try to stop an army of robots by replaying the memory that started it all.

films.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
films.cast: Gregory Walcott, Mona McKinnon, Duke Moore
films.plot: Aliens raise the dead from a California cemetery to stop humanity from building a doomsday weapon.

films.title: Cosmos Laundromat
films.cast: Pierre Bokma, Reinout Scholten van Aschat
films.plot: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.

films.title: Carnival of Souls
films.cast: Candace Hilligoss, Herk Harvey, Sidney Berger
films.plot: After surviving a car crash, a church organist moves to Utah, where she is drawn to an abandoned lakeside pavilion and haunted by a pale stranger.
films.video: Carnival of Souls (1962) by Herk Harvey.webm

films.title: Elephants Dream
films.cast: Tygo Gernandt, Cas Jansen
films.plot: Two men explore a vast, ever-changing machine: old Proog insists he knows its rules, while young Emo starts to doubt it is real.

films.title: A Star Is Born
films.cast: Janet Gaynor, Fredric March, Adolphe Menjou
films.plot: A farm girl comes to Hollywood dreaming of stardom, and rises to fame as the career of the fading star who discovered and married her falls apart.
films.poster: A Star Is Born (1937 film poster).jpg

films.title: Detour
films.cast: Tom Neal, Ann Savage, Claudia Drake
films.plot: Hitchhiking across America to reach his girlfriend, a nightclub pianist is pulled into a spiral of bad luck, blackmail and murder.

films.title: Gulliver's Travels
films.cast: Lanny Ross, Sam Parker, Pinto Colvig
films.plot: Shipwrecked sailor Lemuel Gulliver washes ashore in Lilliput, where the tiny inhabitants are on the brink of war over a wedding song.

films.title: The Phantom of the Opera
films.cast: Lon Chaney, Norman Kerry, Mary Philbin
films.plot: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars of the Paris Opera falls for a young singer and will do anything to make her a star.

films.title: D.O.A.
films.cast: Edmond O'Brien, Pamela Britton, Luther Adler
films.plot: Poisoned and with only days to live, an accountant races to San Francisco and Los Angeles to find out who killed him, and why.

films.title: Charge
films.plot: In a future where energy is rationed, a desperate old man breaks into a power plant and comes face to face with its robot guard.

films.title: House on Haunted Hill
films.cast: Vincent Price, Carol Ohmart, Richard Long
films.plot: An eccentric millionaire offers five strangers $10,000 each to survive a night in a haunted mansion with him and his scheming wife.

films.title: Sherlock Jr.
films.cast: Buster Keaton, Kathryn McGuire, Joe Keaton
films.plot: A projectionist who dreams of being a great detective falls asleep at work and walks straight into the film he is showing.

films.title: Scarlet Street
films.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Joan Bennett, Dan Duryea
films.plot: A meek cashier and Sunday painter falls for a young woman whose boyfriend schemes to exploit him, with deadly results.
films.poster: Edward G. Robinson and Joan Bennett in 'Scarlet Street', 1946.jpg

films.title: My Man Godfrey
films.cast: William Powell, Carole Lombard, Alice Brady
films.plot: A scatterbrained heiress hires a 'forgotten man' from the city dump as her family's butler, and he proves wiser than all of them.
films.poster: My Man Godfrey (1936 poster - Style C).jpg

films.title: The Hitch-Hiker
films.cast: Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy, William Talman
films.plot: Two friends on a fishing trip give a ride to a stranger who turns out to be a killer, and are forced to drive him across Mexico.

films.title: Wings
films.cast: Clara Bow, Charles 'Buddy' Rogers, Richard Arlen
films.plot: Two young men from the same small town, rivals in love, become fighter pilots and best friends over France in the First World War.

films.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
films.cast: Werner Krauss, Conrad Veidt, Friedrich Fehér
films.plot: A sinister showman and the sleepwalker he exhibits at a fairground are linked to a string of murders in a twisted, painted town.

films.title: Animal Crackers
films.cast: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx
films.plot: Chaos descends on a society party when the famous explorer Captain Spaulding arrives, and a valuable painting goes missing.

films.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
films.cast: Frank Sinatra, Eleanor Parker, Kim Novak
films.plot: A card dealer and drummer comes home from prison clean and determined to start again, but his old life won't let him go.
films.poster: The Man with the Golden Arm poster.jpg

films.title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
films.cast: George O'Brien, Janet Gaynor, Margaret Livingston
films.plot: Seduced by a woman from the city into plotting to drown his wife, a farmer rediscovers his love for her over a day in the city.
films.poster: Sunrise - A Song of Two Humans.jpg
films.video: Sunrise - A Song of Two Humans (1927).webm

films.title: Meet John Doe
films.cast: Gary Cooper, Barbara Stanwyck, Edward Arnold
films.plot: A columnist invents a man who vows to protest society's ills, hires a drifter to play him, and watches a national movement take on a life of its own.
films.video: Meet John Doe (1941) by Frank Capra.webm

films.title: The Stranger
films.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Loretta Young, Orson Welles
films.plot: A war crimes investigator tracks a Nazi fugitive to a quiet Connecticut town, where he is hiding as a respected teacher about to marry the judge's daughter.

films.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
films.cast: Buster Keaton, Tom McGuire, Ernest Torrence
films.plot: A gangly college boy joins his gruff father's riverboat business just as a rival owner, and a cyclone, threaten everything.
films.video: Steamboat Bill Jr. (1928) by Charles Riesner.webm

films.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
films.cast: Louis Wolheim, Lew Ayres, John Wray
films.plot: German schoolboys, stirred by their teacher to enlist, discover the reality of the trenches of the First World War.
films.poster: All Quiet on the Western Front (1930 film) poster.jpg
films.video: All Quiet on the Western Front (1930, sound version).webm

films.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
films.cast: Jason Evers, Virginia Leith, Leslie Daniels
films.plot: After a car crash, a surgeon keeps his fiancée's severed head alive in his laboratory while he searches for a new body for her.
films.video: The Brain That Wouldn't Die (1962) by Joseph Green.webm

series.title: King of the Rocket Men
series.cast: Tristram Coffin, Mae Clarke, Don Haggerty
series.plot: Jeff King straps on a rocket-powered flying suit to stop the mysterious Dr. Vulcan, who is stealing the inventions of a secret science foundation.
series.poster: King of the Rocket Men FilmPoster.jpeg

series.title: Zombies of the Stratosphere
series.cast: Judd Holdren, Aline Towne, Lane Bradford
series.plot: Rocket-suited Larry Martin battles Martian invaders who plan to knock Earth out of its orbit with a hydrogen bomb.

series.title: Radar Men from the Moon
series.cast: George D. Wallace, Aline Towne, Roy Barcroft
series.plot: Commando Cody flies his rocket suit to the Moon to stop its ruler, Retik, from conquering Earth with an atomic ray.

series.title: Undersea Kingdom
series.cast: Ray Corrigan, Lois Wilde, Monte Blue
series.plot: Naval officer Crash Corrigan dives in search of the lost city of Atlantis and finds two kingdoms at war beneath the sea.

series.title: The Phantom Empire
series.cast: Gene Autry, Frankie Darro, Betsy King Ross
series.plot: Singing cowboy Gene Autry discovers Murania, a futuristic civilisation hidden deep beneath his ranch.
